test.command: python -m pytest -q tests/test_ablation_plan.py tests/test_horizon_search.py tests/test_bounded_search.py; ruff check src/financial_brain/evaluation/ablation_plan.py tests/test_ablation_plan.py

implemented: Freezes a bounded complete Cartesian grid for entry, exit, horizon, portfolio width, and turnover before outcomes.
Restricts outcomes to the declared TRAINING development window and protects the final window from evaluation input.
Requires every parameter combination to have outcomes for the same dates and decision identities.
Retains exact positive, zero, and negative outcome rows and records all grid-cell summaries.
Archives the plan and complete outcomes in a hash-chained journal with immutable replay checks.
blockers: No adapter executes the project portfolio simulator across every frozen five-axis combination; the archive accepts supplied outcomes.
The development-data digest is declared by the caller and is not resolved against an authoritative dataset manifest.
No complete five-axis ablation run is included in repository evidence.
